responsibility: Defines the shared FreeBSD spec macros used by multiple FreeBSD-related targets without directly overriding generic GCC macro names. It provides FBSD_* forms of OS CPP builtins, CPP/STARTFILE/ENDFILE/LIB specs, dynamic-linker selection, and thread-aware library rules, including the FBSD_NO_THREADS behavior. This header is a reusable spec layer consumed by freebsd.h and some non-FreeBSD derivative targets, distinct from freebsd.h’s direct target macro overrides.
